detection._comment: Tuned for close-range hand-on-screen. depth_delta_mm catches hands 1-5cm shallower than Screen background.

_comment_max_plane_dist_cm: Max distance (cm) in front of calibrated screen plane to register a touch. Tune down toward 5-10cm once calibration plane matches the physical screen surface.

camera._comment: Used when running with --camera. Leave serial blank for first detected device.
